claim: The card's storage boundary: an API protocol for distributing content, which is what a registry implements.
query: OCI Distribution Specification API protocol facilitate standardize distribution of content
snippet: The **Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification** (a.k.a. "OCI Distribution Spec") defines an API protocol to facilitate and standardize the distribution of content.
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification

claim: The sentence that makes this card's subject broader than container images - the protocol does not care what the bytes are.
query: OCI distribution specification designed agnostic of content types
snippet: The specification is designed to be agnostic of content types.
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification
topic: Why a container registry is artifact storage at all

claim: The noun the card names, defined by what it must implement rather than by what it is built on.
query: OCI Registry service handles required APIs defined in this specification
snippet: - **Registry**: a service that handles the required APIs defined in this specification
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification

claim: Content is addressed by digest, which is where immutability comes from at this card - the name is the hash of the bytes.
query: OCI Blob binary form of content stored by registry addressable by a digest
snippet: - **Blob**: the binary form of content that is stored by a registry, addressable by a digest
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification

claim: The operation set, grouped into four named categories rather than listed as verbs.
query: OCI registry APIs categories Pull Push Content Discovery Content Management
snippet:
1. **Pull** - Clients are able to pull from the registry
2. **Push** - Clients are able to push to the registry
3. **Content Discovery** - Clients are able to list or otherwise query the content stored in the registry
4. **Content Management** - Clients are able to control the full life-cycle of the content stored in the registry
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification

claim: Only one of the four categories is mandatory, which means two conformant registries can differ in what they can do.
query: OCI all registries conforming MUST support at a minimum all APIs in the Pull category
snippet: All registries conforming to this specification MUST support, at a minimum, all APIs in the **Pull** category.
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification

claim: A category is all-or-nothing: claiming it obliges every API in it, so capability is declared at category granularity.
query: OCI registries SHOULD also support Push Content Discovery Content Management claiming conformance MUST implement all APIs
snippet:
Registries SHOULD also support the **Push**, **Content Discovery**, and **Content Management** categories.
A registry claiming conformance with one of these specification categories MUST implement all APIs in the claimed category.
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification
topic: What claiming a category commits an implementation to

claim: Errors are typed by a constrained identifier rather than by prose or by status code alone.
query: OCI code field MUST be unique identifier uppercase alphabetic characters underscores
snippet: The `code` field MUST be a unique identifier, containing only uppercase alphabetic characters and underscores.
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification
topic: The shape of an error code

claim: Fourteen typed failures, each with the condition it names, quoted as the table's own rows in page order.
query: OCI distribution error codes BLOB_UNKNOWN DIGEST_INVALID MANIFEST_UNKNOWN NAME_UNKNOWN UNAUTHORIZED DENIED TOOMANYREQUESTS
snippet:
| code-1 | `BLOB_UNKNOWN` | blob unknown to registry |
| code-2 | `BLOB_UPLOAD_INVALID` | blob upload invalid |
| code-3 | `BLOB_UPLOAD_UNKNOWN` | blob upload unknown to registry |
| code-4 | `DIGEST_INVALID` | provided digest did not match uploaded content |
| code-5 | `MANIFEST_BLOB_UNKNOWN` | manifest references a manifest or blob unknown to registry |
| code-6 | `MANIFEST_INVALID` | manifest invalid |
| code-7 | `MANIFEST_UNKNOWN` | manifest unknown to registry |
| code-8 | `NAME_INVALID` | invalid repository name |
| code-9 | `NAME_UNKNOWN` | repository name not known to registry |
| code-10 | `SIZE_INVALID` | provided length did not match content length |
| code-11 | `UNAUTHORIZED` | authentication required |
| code-12 | `DENIED` | requested access to the resource is denied |
| code-13 | `UNSUPPORTED` | the operation is unsupported |
| code-14 | `TOOMANYREQUESTS` | too many requests |
title: Open Container Initiative Distribution Specification
topic: The closed set of error codes

claim: The format standard for what a registry stores, which is a different specification from the API that stores it.
query: OCI Image Format Specification image manifest image index filesystem layers configuration
snippet: This specification defines an OCI Image, consisting of an [image manifest](manifest.md), an [image index](image-index.md) (optional), a set of [filesystem layers](layer.md), and a [configuration](config.md).
title: OCI Image Format Specification
topic: What the stored artifact's format is

claim: The mechanism by which a log, trace or evaluation result is stored as attached to the artifact it concerns rather than beside it.
query: OCI artifacts link reference types subject of another artifact dependencies
snippet:
The OCI distribution specification allows us to "link" OCI artifacts
through the use of the concept of reference types.
Artifacts can be tied to one another by defining one as a subject of another.
title: Attached Artifacts | OCI Registry As Storage
topic: How a result attaches to the thing it is about

claim: The direction of the link, stated plainly - the subject is what is pointed at, not the pointer.
query: ORAS subject refers to the target of a reference
snippet: In this context, "subject" refers to the target of a reference.
title: Attached Artifacts | OCI Registry As Storage

claim: The object-store model's immutability is a configured mode rather than a property of the name.
query: S3 Object Lock write-once-read-many WORM model store objects
snippet:
Object Lock uses a
write-once-read-many (WORM) model to store objects.
title: Locking objects with Object Lock - Amazon Simple Storage Service

claim: Two independent mechanisms, which can both apply to one object version.
query: S3 Object Lock two ways manage object retention retention periods legal holds
snippet:
Object Lock provides two ways to manage object retention: retention periods and legal holds. An
object version can have a retention period, a legal hold, or both.
title: Locking objects with Object Lock - Amazon Simple Storage Service

claim: Retention is time-bounded by default: after the date, the object can be overwritten - the opposite of a digest-named blob.
query: S3 retention period retain-until-date protection expires object version overwritten deleted
snippet:
Each retention period has a retain-until-date that indicates
when the protection expires. After the retention period expires, the object version can
be overwritten or deleted.
title: Locking objects with Object Lock - Amazon Simple Storage Service
